unsure.why: No dialogue or script line in these files sets the first stage; that it follows Fool's Errand comes from Fool's Errand's last journal entry (passphrase found, report to Maro) and this quest's first entry (passphrase in hand, heading to Dawnstar). Whether it begins on reporting to Maro or the moment you read Cicero's journal isn't shown.
How you join the Penitus Oculatus isn't part of this quest; the opening quest has a 'Legion requirement' setting whose conditions aren't decoded here.

The gold amount isn't in these files. The listed items are filled into the quest's item slots in the sanctuary; the records don't say whether they're loot in a chest, on the mannequin, or on display, and one item slot has no item named.
The agents' move into the sanctuary comes from their packages, which switch on once this quest is finished; what the sanctuary becomes for the player (a base, a home) isn't stated.
